title: Ice-age gray farm and granary with 13 tunnels in an L-shaped valley
place_text: L-shaped desert valley, western deserts (central Nevada)

tellings.quote: And in the mountain on the west, they'd cut 13 tunnels in the in the mountain on the west and they used them as a grainery.

plain: Charles Hall says that in an L-shaped desert valley in central Nevada, aliens known as grays (small beings with gray skin) once kept a farm, and they cut 13 tunnels into the mountain on the valley's west side to use as a granary. He dates it to the ice age. Hall describes himself as a UFO whistleblower who spent three years with tall white aliens at Area 51, a secret Air Force test site in Nevada, and he tells Michels about the valley as a place he saw for himself. If true, it would mean aliens were farming in North America long before recorded history.
